judge: The agent completed most of the required tasks but had several issues: (1) MyBank was opened and balances were visible in screenshot 1 (Checking $15,621.00, Savings $4,920.50, Credit Card $4,588.98). (2) SplitPay was opened, balance checked ($250), and all three pending requests under $50 were paid (Maya $42, Leo $17, Kai $33). (3) MegaMart order history was viewed but only the 'Active' orders tab was shown - the agent didn't navigate to 'Past Orders' to tally historical spending; the active orders shown were $151.52, $313.87, $227.31. (4) QuickBite was launched but the agent navigated to what appears to be FreshCart's orders page (showing Trader Joe's, Costco, Natural Foods Market) rather than QuickBite past orders. The QuickBite past orders were actually visible in screenshot 36 showing Chipotle, Sweetgreen, Shake Shack, Starbucks, Whole Foods, Sugarfish orders. (5) FreshCart was opened but the orders shown in screenshot 38 appear to be FreshCart active orders. (6) CloudSheets was updated with categorized totals in cell A9. (7) Notes 'Budget Action Items' was created with savings targets. However, the spending figures used ($192.62 food delivery, $177.71 groceries, $692.70 online shopping, $92.00 peer payments) don't clearly match what was visible in the screenshots - the QuickBite orders visible totaled approximately $192.62 ($28+$19.79+$31.88+$23.27+$32.31+$57.37=$192.62 which does match), MegaMart active orders total $692.70 ($151.52+$313.87+$227.31=$692.70 which matches), peer payments $42+$17+$33=$92 which matches. The FreshCart grocery figure of $177.71 is less clear from screenshots. The agent did not open MyBank explicitly - it appears MyBank was already open from a previous state shown in screenshot 1. The agent started with SplitPay launch. The MegaMart 'Past Orders' tab was not explicitly checked. The CloudSheets update appears to have been entered as a single text string in one cell rather than properly formatted categorized rows.
